attractions.name: Reis Magos Fort
attractions.description: Beautifully restored 16th-century fort built to protect the Mandovi estuary; later served as a residence for Portuguese viceroys and dignitaries; expansive views across the Mandovi River

attractions.name: Reis Magos Church
attractions.description: Peaceful church located beside Reis Magos Fort with a white façade against greenery and the Mandovi landscape; dates back to the early Portuguese period
